source_window.dataset: INSPIRE Index Polygons — local authority downloads

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with bound type/use evidence for an Exeter building. The selected HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons Exeter City Council distribution window is official/public/no-login and publishes indicative extents and positions of registered freehold properties, not physical building footprints; it also carries no record-bound building type/use evidence. Accordingly the source-area geometry is not parcel progress and no individual building record was accepted.
